name: CpmMat
description:
Concrete material, for use with other Cpm classes. 

.. note::

	Density<Material::density> is initialized to 4800 kgm⁻³automatically, which gives approximate 2800 kgm⁻³ on 0.5 density packing.

Concrete Particle Model (CPM)


CpmMat is particle material, Ip2_CpmMat_CpmMat_CpmPhys averages two...

attributes.name: damLaw
attributes.description: Law for damage evolution in uniaxial tension. 0 for linear stress-strain softening branch, 1 (default) for exponential damage evolution law

attributes.name: equivStrainShearContrib
attributes.description: Coefficient of shear contribution to equivalent strain

attributes.name: frictionAngle
attributes.description: Contact friction angle (in radians). Hint : use 'radians(degreesValue)' in python scripts.

attributes.name: isoPrestress
attributes.description: Isotropic prestress of the whole specimen. [Pa]

attributes.name: neverDamage
attributes.description: If true, no damage will occur (for testing only).

attributes.name: poisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: relDuctility
attributes.description: relative ductility of bonds in normal direction

attributes.name: young
attributes.description: elastic modulus [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.
